What to Look For: Explicit mention of digital HACCP implementation, quality software evaluation, or quality system upgrade project
Where to Find It: Company news, LinkedIn posts, job descriptions mentioning 'implementation', press releases
Recommended Action: Personalized outreach referencing the specific project. Offer case study or demo.
Message Hook Example: I saw your team is implementing digital HACCP - we help manufacturers like [similar company] streamline exactly that transition.

What to Look For: Announced new plant, production line, or facility expansion with disclosed timeline
Where to Find It: Press releases, company news section, LinkedIn announcements, construction permits
Recommended Action: Reach out with new facility setup expertise. Offer to help establish digital quality processes from day 1.
Message Hook Example: Congratulations on the new facility in [location] - starting with digital HACCP from day 1 saves months of later retrofitting.

What to Look For: Announced pursuit of new certification (IFS, BRCGS, FSSC 22000), certification upgrade, or initial certification project
Where to Find It: Certification body announcements, company news, LinkedIn updates, audit schedules
Recommended Action: Position as certification preparation support. Audit-ready documentation is key value prop.
Message Hook Example: Preparing for [IFS/BRCGS] certification? Digital HACCP records cut audit prep time from weeks to hours.

What to Look For: Production capacity increase with specific timeline, new production lines with delivery dates
Where to Find It: Press releases, investor updates, construction announcements, equipment supplier announcements
Recommended Action: Tie to increased quality workload from expansion. More production = more quality checks = digital system need.
Message Hook Example: With your production expansion to [X capacity], your quality team's workload will increase significantly - here's how to scale without adding headcount.

What to Look For: Increasing production output, adding production lines, expanding facilities (no specific timeline)
Where to Find It: Company news, About Us updates, production capacity mentions, facility expansion news
Recommended Action: Reference growth trajectory. Position as growth enabler for quality function.
Message Hook Example: Your production growth is impressive - most quality managers tell us manual HACCP becomes unsustainable at your scale.

What to Look For: New retail partnerships announced, supply agreements with major chains, private label contracts won
Where to Find It: Company news, press releases, LinkedIn announcements, retail chain supplier listings
Recommended Action: Reference increased audit pressure from new retail customer. Retail chains demand audit-ready documentation.
Message Hook Example: Congratulations on the [retail chain] partnership - their audit requirements are exactly why manufacturers in your position go digital.

What to Look For: Entering new export markets, international expansion, new country certifications
Where to Find It: Export news, international trade show participation, foreign certification announcements
Recommended Action: Multi-jurisdiction compliance = complex documentation. Position as international compliance simplifier.
Message Hook Example: Expanding to [country] means additional food safety documentation requirements - here's how to manage multi-jurisdiction compliance centrally.

What to Look For: Hiring quality/production leaders, announcing process digitalization, quality improvement initiatives
Where to Find It: Job postings mentioning 'implementation', 'digitalization', 'process improvement', company announcements
Recommended Action: New quality leadership often brings process improvements. Position as quick-win digitalization project.
Message Hook Example: Your new [Quality Manager/Production Director] role suggests you're investing in quality processes - digital HACCP is typically their first quick win.

What to Look For: Job posting for Quality Manager, Food Safety Manager, Production Manager, QA Manager
Where to Find It: LinkedIn job postings, company careers page, Indeed/Stepstone listings
Recommended Action: New hire will need to establish systems and show value. Digital HACCP is common first project for new quality leaders.
Message Hook Example: Your Quality Manager search suggests growth or retirement - whoever joins will likely want digital HACCP as their first improvement.

What to Look For: Existing certification (IFS, BRCGS, FSSC) approaching renewal date, re-audit scheduled
Where to Find It: Certification database lookups, certification expiry dates on certificates, audit schedules
Recommended Action: Renewal audits are good trigger events. Audit prep pain is fresh in their mind from last cycle.
Message Hook Example: Your [IFS/BRCGS] renewal audit is coming up - digital records make the next audit significantly easier than the last one.

What to Look For: Clear evidence of actual food production facilities (not just retail/distribution)
Where to Find It: Website production facility descriptions, Google Maps factory imagery, product manufacturing details
Recommended Action: Structural fit only. Use standard value-based outreach sequence. No special urgency.
Message Hook Example: Help food manufacturers organize daily food-safety controls and corrective actions in one workflow.

What to Look For: Employee count in target range, production scale indicators, facility size
Where to Find It: LinkedIn company page, Firmenabc.at, Unternehmensregister, employee count on website
Recommended Action: Right size for digital HACCP adoption. Use standard outreach.
Message Hook Example: At your production scale, manual HACCP recordkeeping becomes a bottleneck - here's how to streamline it.

What to Look For: Quality Manager exists, quality/food safety roles listed, quality processes mentioned on website
Where to Find It: Careers page, About Us, team pages, LinkedIn employee listings, quality commitment statements
Recommended Action: Quality function exists = potential buyer. Standard outreach.
Message Hook Example: Quality managers at similar-sized manufacturers typically save 10+ hours/week on HACCP documentation.

What to Look For: Current IFS, BRCGS, FSSC 22000, ISO 22000, or HACCP certification

Recommended Action: Certified = quality-invested. More receptive than non-certified. Standard outreach.
Message Hook Example: Your [IFS/BRCGS] certification shows quality commitment - most certified manufacturers we work with digitized HACCP within 2 years.

Where to Find It: Customer logos, retail chain names, private label mentions, retail certifications
Recommended Action: Retail supply = audit pressure. Mention audit-ready documentation.
